title: Pam’s Replacement
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Pam reveals her pregnancy and introduces Cathy as her temporary replacement during maternity leave, sparking suspicion and tension as Pam doubts Jim's denial of attraction to Cathy. Meanwhile, Andy orchestrates a prank involving a fake phone call, and the office band gains a surprising new member in Robert California. Dwight and Pam form a pact to uncover the truth about Jim's feelings, leading to a humorous but inconclusive lie-detector test that raises concerns about Jim's health.
